purpose: Lead-reviewed changes to reconcile at the next safe handoff; not a silent registry mutation.

changes.title: Separate rehearsal evidence from LIVE artifact acceptance
changes.observed: SB-V23-099 depends directly on LIVE SB-S20-007, while its packet only needs a rehearsal result.
changes.proposed: Represent evidence prerequisites explicitly or split a rehearsal sub-artifact before changing dependency traversal. Do not mark the LIVE S20-007 accepted from fixtures.

changes.title: Remove circular operational wording
changes.observed: Operational wording references the SB-V20-004 chain even though measured strategy proof feeds that acceptance.
changes.proposed: Require accepted V1.9 and actual measurements as inputs, not the completed V2.0 aggregate the proof produces. Preserve formal product predecessor gates.

changes.title: Synchronize scoped schema versions
changes.observed: General spec says dataclasses default to version 1; specialist canonical schema is v2.
changes.proposed: Keep existing strategy/planner versions unless deliberately migrated; state explicitly that specialist contracts/results are v2. Match implemented fields and strict readers.

changes.title: Fix stale adopted/proposed and state pointers
changes.observed: Adopted files retain proposed/not-yet-registered wording; STATE management pointer names LEAD-042 while current review names LEAD-043.
changes.proposed: Derive current-state views from one canonical source and replace contradictory headers after verifying the latest review. Preserve historical originals via Git history.

changes.title: Register production integration obligations
changes.observed: H1–H4 excluded from implementation slices and engineering-ready scope.
changes.proposed: Map C12–C15 and C18 into the delivery/acceptance requirements. Never call V2.3 operational without the integrated ordinary entrypoint.

changes.title: Replace provider-label fixture exemptions
changes.observed: adaptive=False is proposed as a fixture exemption.
changes.proposed: Use a reviewed internal offline fixture registry and disabled external routes in rehearsal; production enforces the shared call gate at actual execution.

changes.title: Bound the specialist isolation claim
changes.observed: In-process sandbox/thread deadline could be mistaken for hostile-code isolation/hard termination.
changes.proposed: Specify trusted-adapter scope, supervised process timeouts, and OS-enforced sandbox requirement for untrusted code. Do not break active Fable contract work; add a compatible integration layer.

changes.title: Distinguish component acceptance from connected live behavior
changes.observed: A passing helper/test can coexist with an unused or unavailable production path.
changes.proposed: Store component, integrated, operational evidence scope and lead decision separately; reference one same-SHA integration trace for each claimed product path.

changes.title: Preserve conditional account permission accurately
changes.observed: Owner conditionally allowed existing accounts or a necessary suitable unsubscriber Google Cloud alias; prior blanket account refusal may overstate the restriction.
changes.proposed: Verify actual mechanism and necessity; keep MFA/consent, no-spend and separate public/model grants. No automatic account creation follows from this plan.

changes.title: Use accepted dependencies for promotion, not every safe code experiment
changes.surface: Artifact pull rules and dependency graph
changes.observed: Build readiness, proof prerequisites, and external authorization are mixed into one dependency field.
changes.proposed: Make build input availability, provisional interface use, accepted milestone prerequisites and authority gates distinct. Lead releases provisional safe engineering; workers never widen operational authority.
